history.summary: 1302sqft 3BR at just $1.58M and $1213 psf (~9% below the Oasis median of $1326), carrying the batch's highest URA appreciation at 8.87%/yr. Well-reviewed (9.2/10) 388-unit Pasir Ris development with greenery and beach proximity. The catch is location: 1.32km (~16 min walk) from Pasir Ris MRT, and a thinner 82-transaction base.
history.rating_rationale: Lowest entry price in the batch ($1.58M) paired with the strongest appreciation (8.87%/yr) and a ~9% below-median PSF makes the value case compelling. Pasir Ris benefits from CRL (Pasir Ris interchange) and the Pasir Ris Central redevelopment — real OCR catalysts. Excellent resident ratings and a 388-unit base support resale. Held to Buy (not Strong Buy) by the 1.32km MRT distance, which caps tenant/buyer convenience, and only 82 transactions (moderate liquidity confidence). Strong risk-adjusted entry.
red_flags: 1.32km / ~16 min walk to Pasir Ris MRT — not walkable for many buyers
82 transactions is the thinnest meaningful base among the higher-ranked entries
388 units is mid-sized; fewer comparable resales than 600-unit peers
catalysts: Cross Island Line interchange at Pasir Ris (~2030)
Pasir Ris Central integrated development (mall, bus interchange, polyclinic)
Highest URA appreciation in batch (8.87%/yr) + lowest price + below-median PSF

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Pasir Ris draws families and Changi/airport-linked tenants; demand is decent but the MRT distance limits premium rents. Yield ~3-3.5%.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: 8.87%/yr resale CAGR is the batch high, though on a smaller 82-txn sample so confidence is moderate; CRL and Pasir Ris Central give a credible forward catalyst to sustain above-baseline growth.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_rate_source: URA resale CAGR (82 txns) discounted for sample size and MRT distance
